jobs.jobDescription:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Pro Activation & Success Team

Thumbtack's Pro Activation & Success pillar helps local service businesses discover Thumbtack, get started, find success, and grow with us over time. We build products and experiences that help more pros thrive, partnering closely with marketing, partnerships, and sales across the full pro journey. We're a highly collaborative, data-driven team united by a simple goal: helping pros build stronger businesses.

About the role

Thumbtack was originally built to serve individual professionals and small businesses. Now, larger and more sophisticated businesses represent one of our biggest opportunities for growth — and serving them well requires us to rethink what Thumbtack can offer. In this role, you'll shape how we win with this segment, from connecting Thumbtack with the tools pros use to run their businesses to creating the foundational experiences they need to succeed at scale. You'll work closely with our partnerships and business development teams to turn integrations into meaningful growth, identify and scale new growth levers tailored to this segment, and bring differentiated products to market.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for unlocking growth among larger, more sophisticated pros, with accountability for customer and business outcomes.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how these pros operate, using research and data to identify unmet needs, product gaps, and new opportunities for growth.

  • Set the strategy for our APIs, data integrations, and partner offerings, working directly with partnerships, business development, and external partners to create value for pros and open new growth channels.

  • Lead new products and capabilities from early discovery through launch and adoption, helping complex businesses succeed on a product originally designed for smaller businesses.

  • Partner with engineering to make thoughtful tradeoffs between near-term opportunities and durable technical foundations that can support future products and partnerships.

  • Bring engineering, design, data science, marketing, sales, and partnerships together around clear priorities and lead execution across organizational boundaries.

  • Define success, test the highest-potential ideas, and use what you learn to scale the experiences and growth levers that deliver meaningful results.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex product areas and delivering meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Experience turning ambiguous, early stage opportunities into clear product strategies and taking new products from discovery through launch and adoption.

  • Strong technical fluency and experience owning technically complex products, with the ability to partner with engineering on APIs, data, integrations, and system tradeoffs while keeping customer value at the center.

  • Excellent product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to understand complex business workflows and turn them into simple, intuitive experiences.

  • Strong analytical thinking and business acumen, including the ability to uncover growth opportunities, define success, and balance near-term impact with long-term investments.

  • An AI-first mindset: curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for using agentic AI workflows throughout product development, paired with sound judgment about where AI adds value.

  • Proven ability to influence and lead across engineering, design, data science, commercial teams, and external stakeholders, using clear communication to navigate different incentives and build alignment.

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $200,600.00 - $259,600.00.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $180,200.00 - $233,200.00.

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for this role is currently $170,900.00 - $221,100.00.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Thumbtack embraces diversity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, provincial, state, or local law. We also will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable law.

Thumbtack is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a medical condition or disability during any part of the application process, please contact: recruitingops@thumbtack.com.

For information about how Thumbtack collects, uses, and shares personal information about job applicants, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong is looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive new business and expansion across large enterprise accounts. You’ll own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and pipeline generation through executive engagement, negotiation, and close.

This is an opportunity for a proven enterprise seller who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and knows how to navigate complex SaaS, cloud, or infrastructure sales.

At Kong, we offer uncapped commissions with significant upside, competitive benefits, and equity in a company with strong growth potential.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close and expansion.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline while consistently delivering against revenue targets.

  • Develop relationships with C-level executives and key decision-makers, becoming a trusted advisor.

  • Lead strategic account planning and identify new opportunities within enterprise accounts.

  • Partner across Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical teams to deliver the right solutions for customers.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline management while staying ahead of market and competitive trends.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years of enterprise sales experience, ideally selling into organizations with 5,000+ employees.

  • Proven success closing complex, high-value deals within SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or enterprise software.

  • Strong new-logo/hunter mentality with experience building pipeline and expanding strategic accounts.

  • Experience selling to C-level executives and navigating multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, forecasting, and account-planning skills.

  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.

  • Knowledge of APIs, open source, cloud, or infrastructure technology is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and take ownership of your territory.

Benefits & Growth at Kong:

  • Uncapped Earning & Equity: Competitive base compensation, uncapped commissions, and equity opportunities to share in our long-term growth.

  • Recognition & Rewards: Top performers earn a spot in our annual President’s Club.

  • Career Growth & Support: Structured onboarding, MEDDPICC training, ongoing enablement, and dedicated coaching.

  • Global Scale & Impact: Partner with enterprise customers across AMER, EMEA, and APJ as we shape the future of API and AI connectivity.

  • Award-Winning Culture: 4x Great Place To Work Certified™ (95% employee satisfaction).

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health, wellness, retirement, parental leave, and generous time-off programs tailored by region.

#LI-MM2

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Location

This position is remote within the United States. Living in the Seattle, WA area is preferred but not required.

Position Summary

Join the Middleware team as a Sr. Software Engineer and help us build a fault-resilient, highly available, and customer-centric platform. In this role you will work with the team to build a scalable and secure platform and build customer-facing features that enable security and engineering teams to stop threats in their place! This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about simplification, and eager to dive deep into technology best practices.

Our services and features are written primarily in Python, Golang, TypeScript and React with a focus on security, scalability, stability and type-first design. Our team develops public REST APIs, solves database scalability challenges, implements data migrations, and enables configuration management across our fleet of services.

The R(x) 360 Platform is built on AWS and GCP. It utilizes Terraform to define Infrastructure-as-Code and our services. This platform allows us to build native product and service integrations, first-class customer-facing workflows, and high throughput data pipelines. Our goal is to build a reliable platform for customer-facing services while encouraging healthy work-life balance via automated remediation and fault-tolerant designs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain services written in Go and Python powering ExtraHop’s products.
  • Lead and participate actively in agile development processes, code reviews, and technical strategy discussions.
  • Provide technical leadership to junior team members and leverage design and mentorship experience to help enable the team
  • Act as a technical expert, fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity and collaborative problem solving.
  • Address technical debt proactively, continually improving our codebase and technical stack

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience
  • Solid knowledge of Go, Python, or an equivalent programming language
  • Experience in API development, PostgresQL database design or SQL query performance optimization
  • Experience building and scaling distributed, highly available systems
  • Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and a track record of technical ownership.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in fast-paced, agile environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Django, FastAPI or another Python web framework
  • Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM /Lambdas)

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $180,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Digital Sales Representative - Activate.

About the job

Twilio’s Self-Service Business, serves more than 300,000 active customers and generates nearly $1B annually. This position is needed to grow and retain high-value self-service accounts by engaging customers at the right moment, guiding product adoption, preventing churn, and helping customers reach scale across Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Engage high-value self-service customers through programmatically assigned inbound and outbound leads.
  • Identify growth opportunities by assessing product usage signals, customer needs, and readiness to scale.
  • Guide customers through adoption of Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products to accelerate business outcomes.
  • Retain priority accounts by proactively addressing risks, removing blockers, and supporting continued product value.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Product teams to improve sales plays and customer engagement strategies.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • At least 1 year of sales development or business development experience at a technology company, or 2-3+ years of closing experience in another industry.
  • Ability to qualify inbound and outbound opportunities, uncover customer needs, and guide customers toward relevant solutions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders.
  • Comfort using data, product usage signals, and sales plays to prioritize outreach and identify growth or retention opportunities.
  • Ability to manage a high-volume book of accounts, prioritize effectively, and follow through on customer commitments.
  • Curiosity about cloud communications, customer engagement, email, data, or SaaS products.

Desired:

  • Experience selling SaaS, cloud communications, email, customer data, or developer-focused products.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth, self-service customer motions, or usage-based sales models.
  • Ability to interpret customer usage trends and translate insights into relevant sales conversations.
  • Experience working with Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, or similar sales engagement and CRM tools.
  • Interest in helping customers adopt and scale solutions across Twilio Communications, SendGrid, or Segment products.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, IL, MA, MD, NJ, NY, OR, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, or Washington DC.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Minnesota or Vermont : $30.09/hr - $37.61/hr.
  • Based in Washington D.C., Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay Area): $31.77/hr - $39.71/hr.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or the San Francisco Bay area, California: $33.44/hr - $41.80/hr.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.
  • This role is eligible to earn commissions.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.jobDescription:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026!

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

About the role

At Phantom, we're looking for an AI Engineer to help shape how AI is adopted and scaled across the company. You'll play a key role in building the internal AI tools, integrations, and automation that enable teams to work smarter, move faster, and operate more efficiently.

This is a hands on engineering role focused on turning emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable solutions that drive meaningful business impact. You'll partner closely with teams across the organization to identify opportunities, build AI powered workflows, and establish the technical foundations that make AI accessible, secure, and scalable.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building, experimenting, and shipping, with a strong understanding of modern LLM technologies and the engineering fundamentals required to bring AI solutions into production.

Responsibilities

  • Build AI Solutions: Design, develop, and deploy AI powered tools, agents, and automation that streamline workflows and solve real business problems across the organization.

  • Develop AI Integrations: Connect LLMs and AI applications with internal systems, APIs, and enterprise tools to enable seamless, intelligent workflows.

  • Own AI Infrastructure: Build and maintain the underlying infrastructure, services, and integrations that support reliable AI applications across teams.

  • Enable AI Adoption: Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI, translate business needs into technical solutions, and empower teams to leverage AI tools effectively.

  • Build for Scale: Develop reusable components, frameworks, and tooling that make it easier for teams to build, customize, and maintain their own AI workflows.

  • Ensure Security & Reliability: Implement appropriate access controls, monitoring, observability, and operational safeguards to ensure AI solutions are secure, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Optimize AI Usage: Monitor model performance, usage, and costs while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and business outcomes.

  • Drive Innovation: Stay current with emerging AI technologies, evaluate new models and frameworks, and identify practical opportunities to bring new capabilities into the organization.

Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and maintaining production applications, services, or internal platforms.

  • Hands on experience developing applications using LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or open source models.

  • Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or similar programming languages, with experience integrating APIs and building backend services.

  • Experience building AI agents, workflow automation, or applications that leverage LLM orchestration frameworks.

  • Familiarity with retrieval augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and modern AI application patterns.

  • Experience integrating applications with enterprise tools, internal systems, and third party APIs.

  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure, deployment practices, monitoring, and production reliability.

  • Strong product mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical technical solutions.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • A genuine interest in AI and a bias toward experimentation, execution, and measurable impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building internal AI platforms or enterprise AI automation solutions.

  • Familiarity with AI coding tools, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms.

  • Experience with technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, or similar frameworks.

  • Experience with MCP, enterprise connectors, and AI tool integrations.

  • Familiarity with LLM observability, evaluation frameworks, cost optimization, and usage analytics.

  • Experience implementing security, governance, and access controls for enterprise AI applications.

  • Experience working in a fast growing technology company where speed, ownership, and adaptability are essential.

You'll help make AI a practical and valuable part of how Phantom operates. Success means delivering solutions that teams actively use, reducing manual work, accelerating execution, and creating a scalable foundation for continued AI adoption.

You'll have the opportunity to own projects from concept through production, influence our internal AI strategy, and help define how we leverage AI across the organization.

Why Work With Us

Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people.

  • Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world.

  • Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless.

  • Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation.

Benefits (only available to full-time employees)

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered

  • Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Wellness stipend

  • Weekly meal stipend

  • Learning & Development stipend

  • Remote / WFH set-up stipend

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

jobs.jobDescription:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role

GiveDirectly gives cash directly to people living in poverty and in emergencies. Both depend on the same question: did this person live in this place, at this time? We ask it when we target the poorest households, and when a disaster displaces a community overnight. Location records held by Mobile Network Operators (MNO) can help us estimate an answer to this question at scale. We work with MNOs so they can infer, from their own records, whether a subscriber was resident in a target area over a defined period. Robust residence location inference from MNO data requires in-depth analytical work, and the methods we design have to run on an operator's systems - most often implemented by their engineers - under strict data protection and confidentiality rules.

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to progress our work on location inference from MNO data, and to make it repeatable. Your job is to improve and extend our library of method templates, adapt them to each new operator and setting, and design new elements when an intervention requires it. You'll assess what can be inferred from a given operator's data, specify the analysis clearly enough for their data engineers to implement, then test it with them remotely or on site. You'll support introductory meetings with MNOs, describing methodologies at a high level, and inform the work of data privacy and cybersecurity teams to ensure only necessary data are shared securely. You'll also help colleagues across GiveDirectly understand the strengths and limitations of this data source, so we design programs around questions it can best answer.

This work is live in several countries, and we're expanding it across the countries where we have offices and to low- and middle-income countries anywhere in the world when a crisis hits.

Reports to: Senior Product Manager - MNO data

Level: Senior Manager

Location: At this stage of GiveDirectly’s growth and scale, we’re prioritizing hiring in the countries below, where we can employ you through a GD entity or an established employer of record: Cameroon, Canada, Colombia, DRC, Germany, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Netherlands, Nigeria, Poland, Portugal, Rwanda, South Africa, Spain, Turkey, Uganda, United Kingdom, and United States. This list reflects where our employment infrastructure is established today, and may evolve as we grow. If you’re based elsewhere and not open to relocation, we may not be able to consider your application for this role right now, but we’d encourage you to check back. Please note that we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirement: Substantial international travel, roughly 25 to 50% of your time depending on emergencies, sometimes at short notice - for workshops with operators to support programs and emergency responses.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve and extend our library of analytical method templates for establishing where people live from MNO data, and depending on circumstances, for detecting displacement or estimating poverty. Design novel methods when an intervention requires it.
  • Support colleagues in technical conversations with operators, bringing clarity on the data we need and why, and steering discussions toward technical designs that make the analysis workable.
  • Assess the information that can be inferred from each operator's data given data types and sparsity, and for each geography and targeted area. Support intervention design to account for data quality.
  • Write tests and method specifications for MNO data engineers to implement: steps, parameters, pseudocode, validation criteria.
  • Guide operator engineering teams through implementation, in writing and in person. Adapt methods to accommodate large data volume and computational constraints, balancing accuracy and operational needs.
  • Run in-country workshops with operators to support the set-up of new analyses and - where feasible - tune parameters based on statistical tests and distributions.
  • Feed every new analytical and implementation element back into standard templates, so the next country or intervention starts from a better position than the last.
  • Design for privacy from the start, so that as little data as possible has to be shared: aggregation, minimization, and where useful, privacy-enhancing technologies such as private set intersection or homomorphic encryption.
  • Protect the confidentiality of what operators share with us and improve internal data security processes and tools as we grow.
  • Build internal training material so that our technical and non-technical teams understand the strengths and limits of this data, and design interventions accordingly.

What you’ll bring:

  • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  • Strong mathematical modeling, machine learning and statistics. You choose methods for the question rather than for their sophistication, and you value being able to explain a result over squeezing out the last point of performance.
  • Deep comfort with spatio-temporal data: temporal filtering, GIS, probability distributions, combinatorial reasoning, and working with sparse, irregular observations. Direct experience with Call Detail Records (CDRs) or latching data is a strong plus. Comparable experience with mobility, transport, sensor or remote-sensing data counts.
  • The ability to reason without ground truth. Much of this work has no validated answer to check against, and you're comfortable setting parameters by reading the shape of the data and defending that choice.
  • Pragmatism about the trade-off between accuracy and implementability. You've deliberately simplified a method to fit an operational constraint, and you can say what it cost you.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills. You can explain a method and its limitations to an operator's engineers, to their data protection officer, to their leadership and to colleagues with or without technical background. You write well and are comfortable presenting to these multiple audiences. You build trust with counterparts you don’t manage, and they want to work with you again.
  • Experience writing technical specifications that other teams implemented, clear enough that people you don't manage could follow them correctly.
  • Able to read and review SQL and Python written by others, and to find the logical error in someone else's query. Writing production-quality code yourself is welcome but not required. Enough understanding of large data volumes and databases to judge when analytical simplification is required.
  • Commitment to privacy by design as a foundational value and starting point rather than a compliance step: designing analyses so that less personal data has to be shared. Familiarity with privacy-enhancing technologies for shared computation (private set intersection, secure multi-party computation, homomorphic encryption) is a strong plus.
  • Commitment to confidentiality. You've handled a partner's commercially sensitive data and can describe the habits you built around it, not just the clause you signed.
  • Experience designing training material that changed how non-specialist colleagues used a data source.
  • Comfort in fast-moving contexts where the brief may often shift, and where your technical expertise and understanding may not be shared by other stakeholders.
  • Additional desirable experience may include: poverty modeling; familiarity with survey data and survey instruments; experience inside a mobile network operator or working closely with one; open-source contributions in the mobility estimation space.
  • Comfortable with travel to fragile and post-disaster contexts.
  • Language Requirement: English.
  • Language Preferences: French, Portuguese, Swahili or Spanish.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United State

  • Base Salary: $107,070
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

  • Base Salary: £70,250
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

  • Base Salary: $72,550
  • Bonus at Target Performance: 10%
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Growth Marketing Team

We're a data-driven, highly collaborative team focused on driving sustainable customer growth across paid marketing channels. We combine performance rigor with creative experimentation to unlock meaningful contribution and deliver against Thumbtack's mission of helping homeowners and home professionals accomplish more.

About the role

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to drive core business performance and scale Thumbtack's rapidly growing Paid Social program across channels like Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit.

You're a builder at heart: someone who owns their numbers, pushes ideas outside the current playbook, and has taken a channel or audience from 0 to 1 and made it stick, while collaborating with Creative, Analytics, Martech, and driving performance forward with AI and automation. If you love uncovering the next lever before anyone else sees it, this role is built for you.

What you’ll do

  • Manage and efficiently scale Thumbtack's Consumer Paid Social campaigns across platforms like Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit, driving incremental customer growth and revenue

  • Identify and execute opportunities for channel expansion and unlocking new Social platforms to drive the next frontier of core customer growth

  • Drive our end-to-end emergent Pro (B2B) strategy and execution across Social channels

  • Own in-house campaign management and optimizations, including budget pacing, bid optimization, creative iteration, audience segmentation, and platform best practices

  • Build and implement Paid Social testing roadmaps with cross-functional partners, driving a continuous test-and-learn approach across audiences, creative, and platforms

  • Own tracking, QA, reporting, and measurement for Paid Social, partnering with internal and third-party tools to ensure confidence in results

  • Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to develop and iterate thumb-stopping, performance-driven creative that also advances Thumbtack's brand narrative

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • Bachelor's/Master's in Marketing, Business, Statistics, Economics, or a related field preferred

  • 6+ years of experience managing, scaling, and evolving paid social programs at $X-XX million monthly spend

  • Deep platform and technical expertise in social platforms, with a minimum of 2+ such as Meta, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, and Reddit

  • Proven track record of unlocking growth from new channels and tactics across creative, martech, and AI tooling

  • Strong analytical chops, with experience in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups) and hands-on comfort with incrementality, MMM, A/B testing, lift testing, and attribution frameworks

  • Confident communicator with proven experience collaborating with multiple cross-functional partners

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, high-stakes growth org, with a bias for action, experimentation, and results

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $123,300 - $159,500.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $111,400 - $144,100.

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $104,600 - $135,300.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Volcano (volcano.dev) is a cloud for apps built with coding agents. You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. Most platforms were designed around a person in a console and added agent support later. We started from the agent.

We're a small team and launched publicly in September 2026. Volcano is incubated by Kong and runs as its own company with its own brand.

This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the Volcano Cookbook: recipes that build real apps on Volcano with tools developers already use, written up with the code, the decisions and the gotchas.

  • Build templates and examples people can deploy in one step.

  • Make video, including YouTube, streams and short demos.

  • Run Volcano hackathons, show up at others, and decide which sponsorships are worth doing.

  • Work with the companies whose tools appear in our recipes on joint content.

  • Spend time where developers ask questions, in Discord, on X and on GitHub, and bring what you hear back to the team.

  • Build the tooling and workflows that let a small team publish more without the quality slipping.

  • Be customer zero. You'll hit rough edges before users do, and engineers should be able to act on your reports.

Who You'll Bring:

  • You've built things in public in the last year and can show us what you shipped and how you told people about it.

  • You've done 0-to-1 work: started a company, joined one early, or launched something from nothing.

  • You're technical and fluent with coding agents. You don't need to be a database or infrastructure expert, but you can build a working app with Claude Code or similar, debug it when it breaks, and explain what happened.

  • You write well. You use AI in your own workflow, and you can tell when output reads like slop.

  • You like explaining things, whether to a room, a camera or a thread of skeptical replies.

  • Engineers trust you on technical accuracy.

Bonus Points:

  • An existing developer audience

  • Hackathon organizing experience

  • Experience with developer platforms like Vercel, Supabase, Neon or Cloudflare.

jobs.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

At the heart of our Cloud team is a mission to build a secure, scalable, and high-performance platform that powers our cybersecurity products. As a Senior Software Engineer, Cloud, you will own the design, delivery, and operation of critical cloud services, driving architectural decisions and ensuring systems meet the highest standards of reliability, security, and scalability.

This role goes beyond implementation. You will lead complex technical initiatives end-to-end, influence system design across teams, and set the standard for engineering excellence within the cloud domain. You’ll partner closely with engineering, security, and product teams to solve deeply technical challenges and evolve our cloud platform to meet the demands of a rapidly growing business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, development, and operation of scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant cloud services, with accountability for performance and reliability in production.
  • Drive technical design and architectural decisions for distributed systems, influencing patterns, standards, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end, from design through deployment and ongoing optimization, ensuring alignment with business and technical priorities.
  • Build and scale cloud infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), improving system resilience and efficiency.
  • Advance cloud security and compliance practices, embedding secure design principles, IAM controls, and encryption into all layers of the platform.
  • Improve system observability and operational excellence, implementing robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response strategies.
  • Drive DevOps maturity, optimizing CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies to support rapid, reliable delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and security teams to define solutions and resolve complex system-level challenges.
  • Mentor and guide engineers, providing technical direction, code reviews, and support for skill development while raising the bar for engineering quality.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies, making pragmatic decisions that improve system performance, scalability, and developer productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 6–8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant focus on cloud infrastructure and distributed systems.
  • Proven ability to independently design, build, and operate production-grade systems at scale.
  • Strong proficiency in Go, Python, or similar languages, with experience building distributed services.
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm).
  • Strong experience with AWS services (EKS, EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, IAM), including designing and operating systems in production.
  • Demonstrated ownership of systems, including on-call, incident response, and long-term reliability improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex technical challenges.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.
  • Demonstrated AI literacy, including the ability to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools for software engineering tasks while critically evaluating generated outputs for correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder) or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Expertise in cloud security best practices, including identity, encryption, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience designing and scaling high-availability distributed systems with automated failover and self-healing capabilities.
  • Strong knowledge of observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and microservices.
  • Familiarity with HashiCorp ecosystem tools (Vault, Consul, Packer).
  • Experience contributing to or defining engineering standards, patterns, or platform strategy.

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $180,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Developer Success Engineer.

About the job

In this hybrid engineering and customer success role, you’ll work directly with developers that want to learn how Stytch works, help them design an implementation, and answer any questions they have along the way. Throughout that path you’ll also be serving as the voice of the customer within Stytch and closing the feedback loop by ensuring their insights make it back to our Product, Design, and Engineering teams - or implementing improvements yourself. As the team grows, you’ll have more opportunities to contribute new features to Stytch and Twilio products through code.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build new features and fix bugs in Stytch and Twilio products.
  • Serve as a technical resource for customers when they have questions about our product.
  • Improve documentation and processes for internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • A genuine drive to understand customer needs and concerns.
  • Troubleshooting — Deep curiosity, grit, and tenacity to dig into tough technical issues and track down root causes.
  • Hands-on programming experience in a major language, with 2+ years writing code to build, debug, or automate, in a support, solutions, or software engineering role.
  • Ability to debug others' code (customer integrations, SDKs, open-source libraries) and ship small, well-tested fixes in an existing codebase.
  • Familiarity with modern web services and APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate credibly and effectively at all levels.

Desired:

  • Experience with authentication protocols (SAML/OAuth), MFA, IdP.
  • Prior experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as technical support, solutions engineering, field engineering, etc.
  • Direct experience working on a dedicated software development or product team.

Location

This role will be remote and must be willing to work East Coast business hours.


Schedule

Ability to work non-standard, on-call rotation weekend and holiday hours.


Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.


What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until January 2nd, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.jobDescription:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Brand Strategy Team

We act as the architects of the Thumbtack brand - claiming a distinct position in the market, defining a brand promise that delivers on that position, and partnering with skilled experts across the company to bring it to life. Our work spans brand insights, brand strategy, content strategy, and integrated marketing. We set the roadmap for the brand and extend our influence beyond Marketing & Communications into all parts of the organization to make sure every touchpoint strengthens the brand.

About the role

As the Senior Brand Manager focused on our pro audience, you’ll help define how we position the company, what we promise pros, and how that promise comes to life across every touchpoint. Reporting directly to the Director of Brand Strategy, you’ll set vision for major brand workstreams while shaping how the team and the company think about the pro side of our brand.

What you’ll do

  • Lead foundational workstreams to help roll out our new brand playbook, including defining pro positioning and content strategy, educating and training partner teams, and more — and refresh these artifacts as the market shifts and new learnings emerge.

  • Identify high-leverage opportunities for the brand to drive growth on the pro side of our business, then translate them into clear creative briefs and strategic direction for internal and external creative partners.

  • Own pro brand insights work that informs strategy — including audience deep dives, creative experimentation, competitive analysis, and brand health tracking — and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Partner with channel owners across Marketing and Communications to translate pro brand strategy into an integrated content strategy and creative calendar that meets business and brand goals.

  • Extend the brand’s influence beyond Marketing and Communications by building relationships with cross-functional partners in the product, service and sales organizations; create proactive moments to communicate brand vision and align company priorities to it.

  • Lead brand support for AI-driven content, building prompts, skills, brand review systems, and other infrastructure that allows the brand to scale as content creation becomes more decentralized.

  • Orchestrate brand strategy and creative work for tentpole moments, including campaign launches, product launches, and major events like our annual Pro Summit.

  • Serve as a senior voice on the Brand Strategy team — setting standards, shaping how we work, and driving alignment with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 6-8+ years of brand marketing experience, with a strong focus on brand strategy, positioning, and messaging; experience marketing to SMBs is a plus

  • Experience defining and implementing brand strategy - including brand promises, positioning frameworks, playbooks, and messaging architecture

  • Experience setting brand vision and roadmap, not just managing executions - comfortable operating upstream of campaigns and influencing how the broader org thinks about brand

  • Experience designing and managing brand health measurement programs (brand tracking, awareness, perception, brand lift) and translating findings into clear strategic action

  • Strong creative judgment, including experience writing compelling creative briefs, providing strategic guidance to creative agencies and in-house studios, and partnering with creative teams to develop standout work

  • Experience designing and running creative experimentation programs that improve campaign performance and feed back into brand strategy

  • Analytical rigor — comfortable planning and executing research with the help of internal or external research partners. Adept at synthesizing quantitative and qualitative data into insights, recommendations, and business cases

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected salary range for the role is currently $147,100 - $190,300.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected salary range for the role is currently $132,600 - $171,600.

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected salary range for this role is currently $125,000 - $161,700.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.
