jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

Wpromote is looking for an ambitious, experienced, and self-motivated Manager, Performance Creative to join our growing Performance Creative team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in the fast-paced environment of an agency and is passionate about developing high-performing creative across a variety of digital channels alongside a collaborative and innovative team. Reporting to an Associate Director, this individual will own the development and execution of performance-driven creative across a portfolio of clients, partnering closely with Digital and Motion Designers as well as internal paid media teams.

As a Manager, Performance Creative, you will help shape creative strategy through data-informed testing, iteration, and scalable concepts designed to drive measurable growth across the funnel. This role extends beyond asset creation, requiring a strong understanding of channel dynamics, testing frameworks, and client KPIs to ensure creative performance aligns with broader business objectives.

You Will Be

  • Owning the strategy, direction, and delivery of performance-driven creative across a book of business ranging from 2-5 clients, ensuring alignment with client KPIs and channel objectives
  • Translating performance data into clear creative direction, including testing roadmaps, hypotheses, and iteration plans
  • Developing recurring static and video briefs grounded in platform best practices and performance insights. Inclusive of performance-driven messaging, hooks, headlines, and ad copy tailored to platform behavior, audience insights, and campaign objectives
  • Partnering closely with Media teams to align on testing strategy, scaling opportunities, and performance optimization
  • Collaborating with Design and Production to bring concepts to life, managing timelines, budgets, and deliverables
  • Analyzing creative performance across platforms and synthesize learnings into actionable insights and next steps
  • Applying a strong understanding of platform dynamics (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, Programmatic) to inform creative strategy
  • Supporting client communication by presenting creative concepts, performance insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Contributing to the development of creative testing frameworks, best practices, and ways of working across accounts
  • Identifying opportunities to improve creative efficiency through tools, automation, and emerging technologies
  • Traveling occasionally to visit clients, team meetings, and/or events. Likely 1-3 times/year

You Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience in performance creative, paid social, or a related field, preferably within an agency environment
  • 2+ years of experience owning client relationships and delivering creative tied to performance outcomes
  • A strong understanding of how creative and media work together, with experience partnering with media teams on testing, scaling, and optimization strategies
  • Experience translating performance data into actionable creative direction, taxonomy, testing hypotheses, and iteration plans
  • Working knowledge of paid media platforms, especially Meta Ads Manager, with familiarity across TikTok, YouTube, Amazon, and emerging channels
  • Strong creative and performance marketing instincts, with the ability to develop and iterate on messaging, hooks, headlines, and ad copy that resonate across audiences, platforms, and funnel stages to drive engagement and conversion
  • Ability to identify which creative concepts to scale, iterate on, or pivot from based on performance insights
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with experience managing multiple timelines, deliverables, and workstreams simultaneously
  • Strong client-facing communication skills, including presenting creative work, performance insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Strong awareness of emerging trends, platform evolution, and culturally relevant moments, with a proactive approach to staying current on shifts shaping consumer behavior and creative best practices
  • Actively explores and leverages AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance creative development, optimize workflows, and drive operational efficiency
  • A collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally across Media, Design, Production, and Client Strategy teams

What We Offer

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $75,000 - $85,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

jobs.jobDescription:
Roman aqueducts quietly carried water across cities and made daily life possible. Their value was not in the structures themselves, but in everything they enabled.

The Bank Accounts team plays a similar role at Mercury. We build the foundation for depository accounts*: managing money held in Mercury accounts and helping customers move money between accounts they own.

The work ahead is especially exciting: as Mercury is opening its own bank, this team will build a major part of the foundation needed to manage customer accounts at that scale. The systems and capabilities we build will support how customers open, use, manage, and move money between their accounts.

Your job as an engineering manager at Mercury is to make our banking* core run so smoothly that people barely notice it’s there.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead a team of 4 to 8 senior engineers to deliver high-availability banking services.
  • Translate company and product direction into clear, measurable team objectives.
  • Build a predictable delivery system that makes progress, risks, and tradeoffs visible.
  • Balance customer-facing improvements with platform reliability, operational readiness, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Risk, Compliance, and Operations to make Mercury’s banking products reliable, understandable, and useful.
  • Hire and onboard engineers while maintaining a consistent, high-quality interview process.
  • Hold the team accountable for using AI-assisted development responsibly, with appropriate testing, evaluation, review, and production safeguards.
  • Give clear, useful feedback to engineers at every level.
  • Create an environment where engineers can do their best work and grow their technical and leadership skills.

You should:

  • Have demonstrated the ability to lead a technical team.
  • Have experience building or operating reliable financial, banking, payments, or other high-integrity systems.
  • Be comfortable working across product, policy, infrastructure, and operational boundaries.
  • Be able to turn ambiguous problems into clear decisions, owners, and execution plans.
  • Have strong technical judgment and the ability to engage deeply with system design and implementation.
  • Have experience developing senior engineers and creating opportunities for engineers to lead.
  • Care deeply about correctness, reliability, customer experience, and operational excellence.
  • Be familiar with our tech stack (specifically, Haskell and TypeScript), or have an interest in learning it.

We encourage you to try our demo site if you’re interested in applying for the role.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. About the Role:

Hims & Hers is looking to hire an exceptional Financial Analyst, Category Management to join our strategic finance organization. This role will report to the Sr. Finance Manager, Category Management and is remote-based. As a Financial Analyst, you will own and be responsible for category P&L management, maintaining category financial models and revenue forecasts, building models for new products and pricing decisions, supporting ad-hoc strategic finance decisions, systems management, and customer lifetime value calculations.

You Will:

  • Own customer lifetime value models and be the subject matter expert on the unit economics of your business lines. Guide leadership’s understanding and decision-making for the business

At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Instructure is looking for a high-performing Senior Sales Operations Analyst to serve as the primary Sales Operations business partner for one of our North America (NORAM) Business Units. Reporting to the AMER Director of Sales Operations, this highly visible senior individual-contributor role will work closely with the Business Unit’s sales leadership team to improve forecast visibility, sales performance, and operational execution.

You will coordinate the operating cadence and deliver analytics for your assigned Business Unit, translating data into clear recommendations, identifying risks and growth opportunities, and partnering with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and other Revenue Operations teams. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with sound business judgment, clear communication, and the ability to independently manage defined cross-functional workstreams.

This position can be worked remotely anywhere in the United States.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary Sales Operations partner and trusted advisor to the leadership team of an assigned NORAM Business Unit.

  • Coordinate the Business Unit’s recurring sales operating cadence, including weekly forecasting, pipeline reviews, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Analyze bookings, pipeline coverage, conversion, sales productivity, attainment, and other key performance indicators to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Deliver actionable recommendations that help sales leadership improve forecast accuracy, pipeline health, seller productivity, and overall performance.

  • Support annual and in-year sales planning, including territory and account segmentation, coverage and capacity analysis, quota modeling, and headcount planning.

  • Conduct whitespace, account-potential, and customer-journey analyses to identify opportunities for acquisition, expansion, and improved seller productivity.

  • Partner with Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, and Revenue Operations to align plans, metric definitions, priorities, and execution across the assigned Business Unit.

  • Maintain trusted reporting by monitoring CRM data quality, resolving reporting inconsistencies, and encouraging adherence to established sales processes and governance.

  • Translate business needs into clear analytics, reporting, process, and systems requirements, and partner with technical teams on solution design, testing, implementation, and adoption.

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and streamline operational workflows.

  • Independently lead defined cross-functional projects and analytical workstreams from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.

  • Contribute to AMER-wide Sales Operations initiatives and share scalable practices across NORAM Business Units.

What You’ll Need

  • Three or more years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or a related go-to-market analytical role, preferably within a SaaS or recurring-revenue business.

  • Experience supporting sales leaders as an operational or analytical business partner.

  • A strong understanding of B2B sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, and sales performance metrics.

  • Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets and experience using Salesforce for reporting, analysis, and sales-process support.

  • Experience building, maintaining, or interpreting dashboards using Tableau or a comparable business-intelligence platform.

  • Experience supporting territory design, account segmentation, quota planning, coverage analysis, or sales-capacity modeling.

  • The ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights, recommendations, and leadership-ready communications.

  • Sound business judgment and the ability to constructively evaluate assumptions using data and structured analysis.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional projects, managing competing priorities, and delivering results with limited direction.

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with frontline teams and senior leadership.

  • High attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, process discipline, and operational reliability.

  • A proactive, adaptable approach and the ability to succeed in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with SQL or experience using query-based data to support business analysis.

  • Experience working with Snowflake or another cloud data platform.

  • Experience improving or automating recurring reports and operational workflows.

  • Experience supporting acquisition, expansion, whitespace, or customer-journey analysis in a B2B SaaS environment.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Role

We're looking for a Performance Marketing & Marketing Operations Manager to drive paid media performance and manage the marketing systems that support our growth.

Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation, you'll own campaign execution, budget optimization, and HubSpot operations, helping us reach AI research labs and enterprise AI teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning marketing strategies into measurable pipeline, improving processes, and using data to make smarter decisions.

Your Impact

  • Own and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, X Ads, and account-based marketing (ABM) programs.
  • Manage paid media budgets, including allocation, pacing, and performance against pipeline goals.
  • Build targeted and retargeting audiences using account insights and intent data to improve campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitor cost per lead (CPL), cost per sales-qualified lead (SQL), and pipeline contribution through ongoing A/B testing and performance reporting.
  • Manage HubSpot operations, including workflows, forms, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and marketing automation.
  • Improve lead routing, Sales handoffs, and data quality to support a more efficient conversion process.
  • Maintain UTM tracking standards and build attribution models and full-funnel dashboards that provide actionable insights to leadership.
  • Oversee marketing technology integrations and ensure email marketing compliance with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CASL.
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to improve campaign performance, lead management, and reporting accuracy.

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in B2B performance marketing and marketing operations, ideally in a technology or SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on expertise with LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, including campaign management, optimization, and budget ownership.
  • Strong HubSpot administration skills, including marketing automation, lead scoring, workflows, and lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM), intent data, and audience segmentation.
  • Proven ability to analyze marketing performance, build attribution models, and report on funnel and pipeline metrics.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve everyday marketing workflows, efficiency, and campaign execution.
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage competing priorities independently.
  • A proactive, results-oriented approach with a willingness to test, learn, and continuously improve.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in AI, machine learning, data, or related technology industries.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce administration or CRM integrations.
  • Knowledge of SQL or business intelligence tools such as Looker Studio or Tableau.
  • HubSpot, Google Ads, or LinkedIn Marketing certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you'll have taken ownership of our paid media programs, identified opportunities to improve campaign performance, and strengthened our marketing operations.

You'll establish clear performance benchmarks, improve lead routing and scoring, and deliver reporting dashboards that Marketing and Sales can rely on. Success means maintaining paid media spend within the plan, reducing cost per SQL, and building a more reliable view of marketing's contribution to pipeline.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
CrossFit is seeking a Partner Programs Manager, EDU. You will own the business relationships and contractual performance of CrossFit Education partners. This role leads partner negotiations, contract management, onboarding, ongoing relationship management, renewals, and exits. The Partner Programs Manager works cross-functionally to ensure that obligations are met, partner programs perform against plan, and issues are addressed promptly.

Responsibilities

Contracts and Negotiation:

  • Develop and drive the completion of partner agreements in collaboration with EDU leadership and Legal.
  • Track commitments covering fees or revenue share, course delivery, cancellations, reporting, marketing, and use of CrossFit trademarks.
  • Manage contract amendments, renewals, and partner exits.

Partner Relationship Management:

  • Serve as the primary EDU contact throughout partner engagement, onboarding, ongoing operations, renewal, or exit.
  • Maintain strong partner relationships, resolve concerns, and establish regular business reviews and operational touchpoints.

Contract Delivery and Compliance:

  • Coordinate CrossFit obligations with EDU Operations, Analytics, Product, Content, Marketing, Finance, and Legal.
  • Track partner commitments, including course schedule changes, reporting, participant feedback, promotional obligations, and payments.
  • Escalate unmet obligations and coordinate corrective action or exit when needed.

Standards and Participant Feedback:

  • Implement participant surveys for partner courses; monitor and report NPS, feedback trends, and corrective action plans.
  • Periodically review partner websites and platforms for appropriate use of CrossFit names, marks, and standards.
  • Refer content quality concerns to the EDU Content Manager for review and resolution.

Program Performance and Reporting:

  • Track registrations, revenue, course volume, renewals, and overall partnership performance with EDU Finance and Analytics.
  • Identify performance gaps, recommend improvements, and maintain centralized records of agreements, obligations, contacts, metrics, and renewal dates.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong contract negotiation, commercial judgment, and partner relationship management skills.
  • Ability to translate agreement terms into clear obligations, milestones, and performance measures.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, issue resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Comfort analyzing partner economics, registrations, revenue, renewals, and participant satisfaction data.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple partners and deadlines.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority and manage sensitive partner issues professionally.
  • Working knowledge of partner operations, trademark/brand compliance, and contract lifecycle processes.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, education, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management, vendor management, or contract administration.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating agreements and managing external partner relationships from onboarding through renewal.
  • Experience tracking contractual obligations, program performance, and partner satisfaction.
  • Experience in education, professional learning, certification, licensing, or a related partner-delivered program environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with the CrossFit ecosystem and educational programs. CrossFit Level 1 or higher trainer credential preferred.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

Wpromote is looking for a sharp Paid Social Manager to manage scalable full-funnel paid social advertising campaigns across a portfolio of clients. This is a hands-on role: build campaign strategy, execute high-quality activations, optimize to business KPIs, and partner with cross-functional counterparts such as Creative leads to test social-first creative as well as Data Science leads to operationalize modern measurement. We’re looking for someone who’s dedicated to cultivating curiosity, operates with a learning mindset, and is passionate about driving results while having fun along the way. If we could describe an ideal candidate for this role, words like analytical, strategic, proactive, collaborative, conversion-focused, and creative come to mind.

You Will Be

  • Formulate full-funnel paid social strategies that tie media decisions to client business objectives (e.g., revenue growth, CPA, LTV, lead generation, brand awareness).
  • Own day-to-day campaign setup, activation, and optimization across platforms including Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit, Pinterest, X, Nextdoor, and other relevant channels.
  • Lead client communications for assigned accounts (with Director support), including weekly reporting, optimization rationale, and recommended next steps.
  • Translate creative insights into testable hypotheses and partner closely with Creative leads (in-house teams, Wpromote creative retainers, or third-party agencies) to iterate on social-first creative assets and sequencing.
  • Design and run experiments and A/B tests, capture learnings, and scale winning tactics; track experiment velocity and ensure insights are documented.
  • Apply strict QA, tagging, and tracking discipline to ensure accurate delivery and measurement integrity.
  • Build and maintain measurement-accurate setups, including platform pixel tagging, server-to-server integrations (CAPI/SDK where applicable), and first-party signal capture; leverage tools such as Events Manager and Pixel Helper to identify and escalate gaps to senior measurement partners.
  • Participate in cross-functional pod workflows (Creative, Data Strategy, Paid Search, Programmatic) and execute against shared KPIs.

You Must Have

  • 2–3+ years of paid media experience (paid social, paid search, and/or media buying) in an agency or in-house/client environment.
  • Hands-on experience building, optimizing, analyzing, and reporting on paid social campaigns across Meta and at least one additional platform (e.g., TikTok, Snap, Reddit, Pinterest, LinkedIn, X, Nextdoor, Google).
  • Strong operational fluency with Meta Ads Manager and other platform UIs; comfortable exporting, analyzing, and manipulating campaign data.
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics / GA4 (or tools such as Northbeam, Adobe, TripleWhale, etc.) for basic cross-channel and assist analysis.
  • Solid skills in Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Highly detail-oriented, with strong QA habits and a bias toward documenting processes and results.
  • Facebook Blueprint certification preferred.

Nice To Have

  • Experience leveraging Smartly.
  • Basic SQL skills and/or experience working with BI tools.
  • Exposure to server-side tracking (CAPI), enhanced conversions, and incrementality testing.
  • Experience running audience and creative tests at scale, with familiarity using asset-level diagnostics (e.g., thumbstop rate, hold rate).

Compensation

Additional Information

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $70,000 - $85,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. jobs.jobDescription:
Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways, and we are on track to do the same.

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Leader in North America to lead the segment and scale our Enterprise AE team - West (Mountain, Pacific, Central). There are three primary responsibilities that this sales leader will take on:

  1. Own the revenue outcomes for the segment, with clear accountability for delivering results. Partner with the senior AEs in a team selling motion to maximize our win rates on the company's largest opportunities. Manage deal risks and help navigate the complexities of large-scale competitive replacement deals.

  2. Build a high caliber team in lock step with market demand. In general we believe that smaller, high caliber teams can achieve remarkable results. Your Enterprise team will be an adept group of solution selling experts.

  3. Establish a reputation for excellence by fostering alignment across Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering & Professional Services creating a flywheel for future enterprise customer acquisition.

In this role, you’ll report to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown) and have significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategy and sales methodology. If we are even moderately successful relative to our ambition, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You could be a great fit if:

  • You’ve led and scaled a team of SaaS Enterprise Account Executives delivering $5M/yr+ at a company that has scaled beyond $100M ARR

  • You have helped win $1M+ SaaS deals with publicly traded companies, and can help your team see around corners on complex deals

  • You have a proven track record of hiring and onboarding Ent AEs who can create their own pipeline and close both more tactical ($100k) and strategic ($500k+) deals

  • You have a strong mental model for enterprise sales execution. At the same time, you're a lifelong learner and are open to new ideas and experimentation.

  • You build trusted relationships with customers and confidently facilitate peer-to-peer conversations between senior leaders to deepen partnerships and elevate strategic engagements.

  • You become a product and industry expert. You connect the dots quickly. Customers and your team trust you to provide practical advice and relevant stories.

  • ⚙️ You have successfully sold a complex multi-product platform and have won competitive rip-and-replace sales motions.

Bonus

  • You have sold to Talent and/or People leaders and are familiar with their pains and priorities

You shouldn't apply if:

  • You're a dashboard-and-forecast manager who doesn't like to get into the deals and daily operations

  • You're not keen on learning our substantial product. "That's for SEs" isn't how we approach things here.

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We have clear expectations about what it means to be a leader at Ashby

  • We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals

  • We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the TA space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience

  • We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best product makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Enterprise segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

  1. Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Recruiting to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.

  2. Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the leader you are today.

  3. Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with pipeline data and seek your perspective on the segment. You'll discuss your approach to hiring, coaching and sales execution.

  4. Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with cross-functional leaders

Benefits

  • A product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about

  • Competitive salary, commission and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.jobDescription:
Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 300,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. This turns out to be a pretty wild endeavor, so we’re looking to bring someone smart onto our Customer Support team to help us out.

As a member of our Customer Support team, you’ll make sure our users are charmed by warmth and competence when they have questions or needs that aren’t being met by our product. You’ll radiate intelligence while exercising your best human qualities, like compassion and empathy, even in the face of frustration.

You’ll need to understand how our product works in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You’ll Do:

  • Answer user questions over chat, email, and phone
  • Handle user account requests, including application processing, card disputes, missing payments, card shipments, and a whole lot more
  • Teach customers how to use our product (hopefully most of it is self-explanatory), and translate user confusion into product suggestions
  • Identify the systemic flaws that lead to user problems
  • Work with our engineering team to find and squash bugs
  • Communicate our users' needs to our partner banks and work with them to improve their products and processes
  • Write help articles and FAQs
  • Learn our internal tools and figure out how to improve them
  • Put in place processes to make your job more efficient
  • Help with other compliance and customer tasks
  • Create and sustain warm relationships with our users
  • Help build out the customer support and ops infrastructure at Mercury

What You Bring:

  • Have 2+ years of experience in a Customer Experience / Customer Support role
  • Consistently exercise empathy
  • Always seek to answer the question behind the question
  • Understand how to translate complex terminology into clear, human user communication
  • Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible
  • Keep a clean, ordered inbox
  • Stay calm and collected while working on ten things at once
  • Feel confident talking with startup folks in person, over chat, or on the phone
  • Use creativity while working within difficult constraints
  • Show kindness in the face of unpleasantness (our customers generally are really great, but they can get passionate when it comes to their businesses)

Would be nice if you:

  • Have experience working in retail branch banking
  • Are passionate about uncovering customer needs
  • Enjoy solving customer problems and proactively offering solutions to unmet needs

Schedule Information:

  • Required: be available to work at least one weekend day per 5 day shift
  • We are currently hiring for multiple shifts. Openings will be covered early in the interview process
  • Your working schedule will be fixed - this is long-term commitment, not a rotating shift

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

#LI-RP1

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:

$48,100—$58,400 USD

US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:

$43,300—$52,500 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an experienced, self-motivated, and results-driven Staff Engineer to build, test, deploy and support our self-service platform used for pharmacy operations and customer order fulfillment.

As a leading technical voice within the Fulfillment and Pharmacy Engineering Front End team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product managers, designers, and Engineering leaders to deliver solutions for our Fulfillment and Pharmacy Operations teams. Your contributions will help ensure the resulting platform is safe, reliable, scalable, and adaptable to our growing business needs.

You Will:

  • Lead the architecture of scalable, maintainable, and performant front end solutions aligned with product requirements

  • Work with other technical leaders to identify and drive adoption of common frameworks, patterns, and practices

  • Establish and foster consistent best practices, design patterns, and coding standards across the Front End team

  • Shape responsible adoption of AI across our software development process, raising team output while holding the bar for patient safety, quality, and maintainability

  • Guide the technical growth of Front End engineers through pair programming, mentorship opportunities, maintaining thorough technical documentation, and other avenues

  • Initiate efforts to reduce technical debt and enhance workflow efficiency

  • Implement tools and processes for monitoring, incident response, and performance optimization

  • Define a multi-quarter front end architecture roadmap for Pharmacy & Fulfillment and break it into work other engineers can pick up

  • Collaborate with designers for intuitive and engaging user experiences

  • Conduct design & code reviews and facilitate knowledge-sharing initiatives

  • Stay informed of industry trends and standards to propose innovative enhancements

You Have:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of setting front end technical direction across multiple teams

  • Proven experience in building scalable web applications and services, preferably in a cloud environment

  • Proficiency in front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks (React, React Native, NextJs, TypeScript) and back-end technologies (Node.js, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis)

  • Experience with monitoring and CI/CD technologies (Datadog, Github actions, Circle CI, etc…)

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in real engineering workflows, with good judgment about where they help and where they don't

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and strategically

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams

  • Capable of prioritizing multiple projects in order to meet goals without management oversight

Preferred Experience

  • Identifies clarity in ambiguous situations, acting as a stabilizing influence during uncertainty.

  • Fosters trust and collaboration across diverse teams

  • Balances confidence with humility, constructively addressing conflicts and resistance.

  • Provides empathetic feedback and promotes transparency

  • Strategically drives execution of initiatives, maintaining urgency and focus on critical priorities

  • Champions customer-centric design and ensures customer priorities are reflected

  • Demonstrates accountability, owning outcomes and the long-term success of technical systems

  • Proactively identifies and addresses risks and gaps without awaiting direction.

  • Promotes curiosity, continuous improvement, and innovation

  • Influences decisions through well-reasoned arguments and supports alignment post-decision

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

jobs.jobDescription:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

We are seeking a Director of Customer Success to lead our NORAM K12 Customer Success team. You'll lead a team of Managers, as well as their Customer Success Managers and Customer Success Associates, to ensure the success of our entire NORAM K12 customer base. This is a highly visible role that partners daily with Sales, Renewals, Marketing, Services, Support, and Product, represents NORAM K12 in global Customer Success strategy, and builds executive relationships with key schools, districts, and states.

You’ll lead the team that shows up as a strategic partner, a trusted thought leader, an advocate, and a connector for every district we serve. That means business reviews worth a superintendent's time, value realization measured against institutional outcomes, and a customer voice that reaches the people building our products. You'll own what that looks like for NORAM K12: the business unit strategy, the team that delivers it, and the cross-functional relationships that make it possible.

What you will be doing:

Leading the NORAM K12 Customer Success team:

  • Lead a team of Managers who own the Strategic, Senior, Enterprise, Associate CSM, and CSA segments, coaching them to upskill and grow their teams.

  • Own hiring, onboarding, performance, career development, and succession planning for the team, and build a bench that can absorb growth.

  • Set the coaching standard: what good looks like in a value conversation, a renewal forecast, a risk escalation, and a Business Review.

  • Hold a consistent operating rhythm of 1:1s, team meetings, forecast calls, and business reviews that keeps managers accountable and the team connected.

  • Balance workload and territory coverage across the team, and adjust as accounts, tiers, and headcount shift.

  • Design the organization: headcount, team structures, segmentation, and reporting lines that fit the strategy.

Setting the NORAM K12 CS Strategy:

  • Co-own the go-to-market strategy with the sales leader and cross-functional partners, and shape the strategy so business unit and CS+R priorities are aligned.

  • Drive adoption and expansion across the Instructure product portfolio.

  • Share accountability for renewal rate, pipeline generation, and non-renewal bookings across the NORAM K12 book, as the result of adoption and value work done well.

  • Run an accurate, defensible forecast, and surface risk early enough to intervene.

  • Own the quality, cadence, and coverage of business reviews across the NORAM K12 portfolio, and define what a good one looks like.

Serving as a senior customer and market voice:

  • Build executive relationships with our most strategic districts, statewide consortiums, and state agencies, and join the conversations where a leader's presence changes the outcome.

  • Act as an executive escalation point when needed, and stay the steady voice when a customer situation is tense.

  • Serve as a trusted expert on K-12 trends, internally and with customers, including emerging risks and market opportunities: funding cycles, procurement realities, policy shifts, and what districts are being asked to solve.

  • Advocate for NORAM K12 customers with Product, Engineering, Support, and Marketing, and translate their needs into priorities those teams can act on.

  • Support regional user groups, customer advisory work, and reference and advocacy programs.

Collaborating to shape global Customer Success strategy:

  • Partner with the global Customer Success Strategy team to shape plays, playbooks, value frameworks, and enablement, and make sure NORAM K12 realities are built in rather than bolted on.

  • Lead the regional rollout of global initiatives, and hold the line on adoption once the launch is over.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success leaders in other regions and segments to keep our approach consistent where it should be and different where it needs to be.

  • Define what good looks like globally, including expectations and accountability frameworks, and align with peer CS leaders on one vision.

  • Own the OKRs for the Customer Success organization, in partnership with other Customer Success leaders.

Here is what you will need to know/have:

Successful candidates will have the following education, experience, and skills:

  • Experience turning a company vision into work that teams can execute, in a Customer Success, account management, or post-sales organization.

  • A track record of leading managers, not only individual contributors, and growing leaders who decide without you.

  • Experience building team structures, spans, and segmentation models that fit a strategy, and making the case for changing them.

  • Strong leadership presence with both customers and internal executives, including the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.

  • Experience forecasting a book of business accurately, and sizing the impact of risk and expansion possibilities.

  • Deep knowledge of the K-12 education market, including district and state budget cycles, procurement, funding sources, and how decisions actually get made in a school system.

  • Using AI to fundamentally change how teams operate.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work in Gainsight, Salesforce, and reporting tools to turn data into a decision.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate customer detail into business impact for executives.

  • A calm, decisive presence under pressure, with the judgment to manage ambiguous, high-stakes situations across multiple stakeholders at once.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites, conferences, and team onsites.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

jobs.jobExcerpt: CrossFit is seeking a Director of Affiliates—a proven business leader and experienced affiliate owner to lead our affiliate business and ensure HQ effectively serves and empowers the global CrossFit affiliate community. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the teams responsible for supporting, expanding, and strengthening the global affiliate network. You will define the…
jobs.jobDescription:
CrossFit is seeking a Director of Affiliates—a proven business leader and experienced affiliate owner to lead our affiliate business and ensure HQ effectively serves and empowers the global CrossFit affiliate community.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the teams responsible for supporting, expanding, and strengthening the global affiliate network. You will define the strategic vision, drive key performance metrics, and collaborate across all HQ departments to deliver practical, high-impact solutions for affiliate owners.

As someone who has operated an affiliate, managed operations, coached athletes, and driven business growth, you will leverage your firsthand operational experience to support thousands of affiliate owners in scaling sustainable, successful businesses.

Key Outcomes

  • Network Growth & Retention: Drive affiliate network expansion while enhancing retention strategies and tracking core performance metrics.
  • Affiliate Advocacy & Support: Provide robust operational support, foster direct feedback channels, and serve as the primary advocate for affiliate owners within HQ.
  • Operational Excellence: Streamline business operations, establish clear performance benchmarks, oversee budget allocation, and leverage data-driven insights.
  • Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team focused on execution, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Business Model Optimization: Enhance unit economics for affiliates and ensure all HQ initiatives deliver tangible value to local gym owners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Execution: Lead overall strategy and execution for the affiliate business unit, maintaining accountability for quarterly performance targets.
  • Community Engagement: Engage directly with affiliate owners through site visits, community events, and roundtables to gather field intelligence and align HQ priorities.
  • Unit Economics: Analyze affiliate unit economics to identify drivers of sustainability, growth, and operational risk across the network.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner cross-functionally with Education, Sport, Marketing, Product & Technology, Finance, and Legal to ensure cross-departmental alignment.
  • Budget Management: Manage the departmental operating budget in collaboration with Finance, optimizing resource allocation to yield high impact for owners.
  • Operational Improvement: Monitor key performance indicators, streamline workflows, and remove operational friction for local gym operations.
  • Team Mentorship: Coach, mentor, and cultivate leadership development within the affiliate operations team.

Qualifications & Core Competencies

  • Affiliate Ownership: Current ownership and operational experience with a CrossFit affiliate.
  • Certifications & Open Participation: Active CrossFit Level 4 (CF-L4) certification and ongoing active participation in the CrossFit Open.
  • Strategic Analysis: Strong analytical and strategic planning skills with a focus on measurable outcomes.
  • Affiliate-First Leadership: Agile, affiliate-first leadership style with a dedication to eliminating low-value processes.
  • Team Building: Proven capability to build trust, inspire teams, and develop talent effectively.

Education & Experience

  • Executive Leadership: 10+ years of progressive executive leadership in business operations, account management, franchise/network operations, or professional services.
  • Remote Team Management: Demonstrated expertise managing senior leaders and leading geographically dispersed or remote organizations.
  • Growth & Scaling: Proven track record of driving operational scale, financial growth, and customer retention metrics.
  • Operational Frameworks: Experience designing and implementing scalable operational frameworks and organizational structures.
  • CrossFit Ecosystem Domain Expertise: Deep domain expertise and understanding of the CrossFit affiliate model and ecosystem strongly preferred.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

Wpromote is looking for a Group Account Director to lead the growth, retention, and strategic direction of some of our largest B2B client relationships. You will serve as a senior strategic partner to clients, bringing deep experience in digital marketing, lead generation, and customer acquisition across long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying journeys.

Reporting into the Head of B2B Client Delivery, you will oversee a portfolio of complex B2B accounts while guiding the account teams responsible for their success. You will develop trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, translate business and marketing objectives into integrated strategies, and ensure Wpromote delivers measurable value across every engagement. This role will also be responsible for identifying organic growth opportunities, managing account health and profitability, and developing account leaders across SaaS, professional services, and enterprise clients.

You Will Be

  • Serving as the senior relationship leader and escalation point across a portfolio of complex B2B client accounts
  • Building trusted partnerships with VP and C-suite client stakeholders and advising them on business, marketing, and growth priorities
  • Overseeing the growth, retention, strategic direction, and overall health of assigned client relationships
  • Identifying and advancing organic growth opportunities across existing accounts while supporting broader new business efforts
  • Developing a deep understanding of each client’s business, category, market, buying committee, competitive landscape, and ideal customer profile (ICP)
  • Bringing strategic and innovative ideas to client engagements by partnering with Wpromote specialists and applying a strong understanding of cross-channel marketing dynamics
  • Guiding the development of integrated, full-funnel marketing strategies across channels such as Paid Search, Organic Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, YouTube, Email, and Content
  • Overseeing all aspects of client statements of work, including deliverables, renewals, scope changes, and change orders
  • Leading executive-level client meetings, quarterly business reviews, annual planning sessions, and other strategic conversations
  • Interpreting data from analytics, CRM, and marketing automation platforms such as GA4, Salesforce, 6sense, Demandbase, Marketo, Pardot, and HubSpot to assess performance and identify opportunities to drive pipeline and revenue growth
  • Ensuring marketing strategies align with client goals, sales priorities, and measurable business outcomes
  • Managing the financial health and profitability of assigned accounts, including staffing, resource allocation, agency hours, forecasting, and scope management
  • Collaborating with Strategy, Creative, Media, Analytics, and Martech teams to deliver cohesive campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Providing strategic oversight and quality control across client deliverables
  • Anticipating account risks and developing proactive plans to protect client relationships, retention, and business performance
  • Leading, developing, and motivating Account Directors and other account team members while fostering collaboration, accountability, and continued growth
  • Helping improve account management processes, standards, and best practices across Wpromote’s B2B practice

You Must Have

  • 10-12+ years experience managing client relationships across SaaS, professional services, or other complex solution categories in an agency environment
  • 5-6+ years of B2B client management experience
  • Experience overseeing a portfolio of complex, enterprise-sized client relationships and guiding multiple account teams
  • A demonstrated track record of strengthening client relationships, retaining business, and identifying organic growth opportunities
  • Experience developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies across Paid Search, Organic Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, Email, Content, and other relevant channels
  • Experience leading full-funnel digital programs spanning awareness, demand generation, lead nurturing, pipeline acceleration, and sales enablement
  • A strong understanding of B2B sales cycles, buying committees, and funnel stages from MQA through closed-won, with the ability to align marketing programs with revenue KPIs
  • Experience leveraging CRM, marketing automation, and intent data platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, 6sense, and Demandbase to inform strategy and reporting
  • The ability to translate complex media, attribution, and business performance data into clear insights and recommendations for VP and C-suite stakeholders
  • Strong strategic marketing capabilities, including competitive assessments, industry analysis, audience segmentation, and go-to-market planning
  • Experience successfully overseeing multiple enterprise-sized clients with combined media budgets exceeding $80 million
  • Strong financial acumen, including experience managing account profitability, scopes of work, staffing plans, and resource allocation
  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing account leaders and cross-functional teams
  • The ability to foster collaboration and influence teams across disciplines without direct authority
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management skills
  • The ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams and perform effectively under pressure
  • An energetic, solutions-oriented approach and passion for client leadership
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with multi-touch attribution and media mix modeling
  • Experience supporting enterprise new business pitches and RFP responses
  • Experience helping scale account management processes or capabilities within a growing B2B practice

Compensation

Additional Information

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

Tenable’s Director, Global Government Affairs (SLED) represents Tenable before state and local legislators, Chief Information Officers (CIOs), Chief Information Security Officers (CISOs), procurement officials, and education leaders, as well as across national SLED organizations, trade associations, and coalitions.

This position develops and executes comprehensive state and local advocacy strategies in tight alignment with Tenable’s SLED sales and business development leadership. A core element of the role involves monitoring state policy developments, managing contract lobbyists in target jurisdictions, and turning association and legislative intelligence into actionable growth strategies for field sales teams.

Your Opportunity:

  • Public Sector Business Enablement: Partner closely with SLED territory sales teams and sales leadership to open doors, navigate procurement cycles, and highlight the operational value of exposure management solutions to state and local leaders.
  • Consultant & Lobbyist Management: Directly direct and manage outside government relations consultants and contract lobbyists in key priority states (including California, Texas, New York, and Florida), setting priorities and ensuring measurable results.
  • Trade Association & Coalition Leadership: Represent Tenable within key technology associations and national SLED bodies (e.g., NASCIO, NGA). Actively monitor state legislative trends and translate association briefings into timely, actionable commercial intelligence for regional sales teams.
  • Executive Relationship Building: Cultivate and sustain deep, credible relationships with state CIOs, CISOs, state agency technology leaders, and key procurement decision-makers nationwide.
  • Policy Strategy & Legislative Tracking: Track, evaluate, and influence state and local legislation and executive policies impacting cybersecurity standards, AI adoption, and public sector risk management.
  • Ethics & Lobbying Compliance: Navigate state-specific lobbying rules, gift restrictions, and disclosure requirements in close coordination with Tenable legal and compliance teams.
  • Solution Advocacy: Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of Tenable’s exposure management platform and its application to state, local, and higher education operational resilience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align government affairs strategies with product marketing, corporate communications, and executive leadership priorities.

What You’ll Need:

  • Minimum of 7+ years of relevant experience in state and local government affairs, public policy, state agency administration, or SLED business development, with demonstrated leadership experience.
  • Proven track record establishing credibility and working relationships with state and local CIOs, CISOs, IT procurement officials, and legislative staff.
  • Demonstrated experience managing external government affairs consultants and contract lobbyists to achieve targeted policy and business outcomes.
  • Strong working knowledge of state legislative processes, budget appropriation cycles, and public sector acquisition vehicles.
  • Demonstrated success leveraging national intergovernmental organizations and trade associations to represent company priorities.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex policy topics to commercial sales teams and government executives alike.
  • Travel: Domestic travel required, typically monthly to quarterly depending on state legislative calendars, major SLED conferences, and jurisdictional priorities.
  • Availability: Planned position start date of March 2027.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.

And Ideally:

  • Working familiarity with cybersecurity principles, IT infrastructure, enterprise software, or AI policy (formal cybersecurity industry experience is not required; domain-specific exposure management solutions can be learned on the job).
  • Prior service as a state Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Deputy CIO/CISO, or senior state technology leader.
  • Direct experience overseeing legislative or consulting engagements in including California, Texas, New York, or Florida.
  • Experience serving as an intelligence bridge between public sector associations and quota-carrying sales representatives to accelerate pipeline generation.
  • Advanced degree in Public Policy, Public Administration, Political Science, Law, or a related field.

Joining Collibra’s Public Sector team

Make an impact at Collibra Public Sector by driving growth in US federal DOW agencies. You will be actively involved in the entire sales cycle creating initial demand, progressing the opportunity through the technical and financial decision process, and ensuring adoption and expansion after the sale.

Collibra Public Sector Account Executive II, Federal at Collibra are responsible for

  • 5+ years in a technical customer facing role, ideally supporting Enterprise Class customers in an SaaS environment.
  • Experience in Technical Account Management, Support or similar type of Premium or Signature Service organization dealing with Enterprise Software Application Support.
  • Experience troubleshooting web-based applications.
  • Experience with Java, REST API and SSO and a working knowledge of kubernetes, with VM, SQL, SSL, SSO, and LDAP a plus.
  • Experience and a strong interest in developing deep customer relationships while facilitating discussions about enterprise IT architecture.

  • Prior relationships with Departments of Defense/War, Army, Fourth Estate.
  • Originated and closed complex sales with multiple technical and business stakeholders.

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience.

  • Within your first month, you will have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers.
