About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Staff Platform Engineer to set technical direction for our platform, not just build within it. This is the most senior IC role on the team: you'll own architecture for our most consequential, cross-org infrastructure initiatives, and be the person other senior and staff engineers look to when a design decision needs to hold up across every team that depends on it. Recent and current flagship work at this level includes leading the Istio service mesh rollout as single-threaded owner across the entire organization; shaping the architecture behind our Multi-Region Resilience Program; and owning the technical direction of our AI-enriched Service Catalog. You'll operate at the intersection of deep technical execution and org-wide influence, staying hands-on in critical code and infrastructure paths while setting the patterns other teams build on.

You Will:

  • Own group-critical platform initiatives: Take single-threaded ownership of multi-quarter, cross-org programs — service mesh adoption across independent clusters and business units, multi-region resilience strategy, and foundational platform initiatives. Align systems and abstractions to long-term organizational strategy.

  • Set direction others build on: Define the architectural patterns, golden paths, and platform primitives (Istio mTLS/traffic policy, AI agent golden paths, MCP-backed service APIs) that other engineers implement against. Create shared components that improve delivery consistency across teams rather than one-off solutions per squad.

  • Lead through hands-on technical excellence: Stay deeply engaged in the hardest parts of the systems you own — debugging production incidents at the mesh layer, hardening migration tooling, resolving cross-team architectural conflicts — earning credibility through visible, high-quality technical work rather than through title alone.

  • Drive execution across organizational boundaries: Coordinate rollouts that depend on multiple engineering orgs contributing resources on a schedule (e.g., a named engineering champion per business unit for a service mesh migration). Anticipate systemic blockers — resourcing gaps, conflicting migration sequencing, environment drift between staging and production — and resolve them before they stall the program.

  • Own testing infrastructure strategy end-to-end: Serve as DRI for how engineering teams validate changes before production, spanning iteration environments, pre-prod confidence gates, and multi-service validation for cross-service changes.

  • Mentor Staff and Senior engineers: Coach engineers below you on system design, migration strategy, and how to navigate ambiguity in cross-team initiatives. Raise the technical bar of the org by example, not just by review.

  • Drive org-wide reduction of technical debt and cost: Lead large-scale infrastructure consolidations and migrations (CI/CD platform changes, artifact registry modernization, dependency upgrades) end-to-end, with the rollout discipline, cost modeling, and stakeholder communication that a multi-hundred-repo change demands.

  • Establish the metrics that prove platform investment works: Define and drive adoption of the leading indicators — adoption rate, incident trends, cost trajectory, developer sentiment — that let leadership see platform work as a business asset, not overhead.

You Have:

  • 12+ years in Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE roles, including demonstrated ownership of at least one initiative that spanned multiple teams or business units, not just a single team's roadmap.

  • Deep, production-proven expertise in Kubernetes/EKS, service mesh (Istio strongly preferred — mTLS, traffic shaping, sidecar architecture, multi-cluster rollout), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar) at meaningful scale.

  • A track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical programs from architecture through execution — including the ability to produce the kind of cost/risk analysis and phased proposal that secures leadership buy-in and funding.

  • Experience debugging and resolving production incidents in distributed, multi-hop systems (e.g., proxy/sidecar-layer failures, cross-service auth issues, environment-specific config drift between staging and production).

  • Proficiency in at least one of Go, Python, TypeScript, or Java, with the judgment to know when to write code yourself versus when to set direction and delegate.

  • A demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority — driving alignment across engineering orgs that don't report to you, and building the kind of technical credibility that makes other senior engineers want to build on your patterns rather than route around them.

  • Experience mentoring Staff-level engineers and shaping how a broader engineering org approaches system design, not just your immediate team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-native platform tooling: agentic tooling, MCP-backed APIs and golden paths for deploying AI agents in production.

  • A track record of driving large-scale cost or infrastructure consolidation initiatives (CI/CD platform migrations, cloud cost optimization, vendor consolidation) with measurable business impact.

  • Experience with multi-region or high-availability architecture, including RPO/RTO planning and per-journey SLO definition.

  • Comfortable authoring RFCs and leadership-facing technical proposals and presenting them directly to senior engineering leadership.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for a backend software engineer to lead the design and implementation of Deepgram’s products. You will design and implement secure, robust, and scalable services for speech processing; efficient, distributed compute orchestration; optimized scheduling, and more. Your skill at building highly reusable code that overcomes technical challenges is paired with an intuition for delightful user experiences. You will be a critical voice in Deepgram’s Product and Engineering teams, driving high impact products from start to finish.

What You’ll Do

  • Improve Deepgram’s core inference services including areas in networking, speech processing, audio transcoding, and latency and memory optimization

  • Develop processes for measuring, building, and optimizing services to maximize system performance

  • Debug complex system issues that include networking, scheduling, and high performance computing interactions

  • Rapidly customize backend services to support our customer needs

  • Partner with Product to design and implement new services, features, and/or products end to end

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, impact-driven environment where learning new skills on-the-fly is not only encouraged but a regular necessity

  • Enjoy balancing decisions about product and feature maturity to decide when to make minimally invasive changes versus when to incorporate detailed design work

It’s Important To Us That You Have

  • 3+ years of experience in an industry role

  • Programming experience in Rust (or C, C++), with competence in Python

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, both written and verbal.

  • A high level of experience and understanding of version control; preferably git.

  • Comprehensive experience with UNIX-style systems.

It Would Be Great if You Had

  • Experience with modern machine learning, such as experience with a framework like Torch or implementation knowledge of architectures like CNNs, RNNS, and transformers

  • Experience with audio processing

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
LOCATION:

The Senior Growth Manager is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required, for client meetings or other internal meetings, conferences, etc.

THE ROLE:

Acceleration Partners is seeking a Senior Growth Manager to drive partner growth strategies for some of our largest and most complex client programs. In this role, you will identify, develop, and scale high-impact partnerships that drive measurable revenue growth and help clients achieve their business objectives. You will shape recruitment, activation, and optimization strategies, uncover emerging growth opportunities, and influence partnership roadmaps beyond traditional affiliate models.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Revenue:

  • Publisher & Partner Performance: Contributes to client growth and retention by building high-potential partner relationships and optimizing performance. Prioritizes the client’s most strategically important partner relationships and is trusted to make judgment calls on where to invest time without needing direction.
  • Performance Trackers & Reporting: Follows client-approved processes for paid placements and partner optimizations. Uses reporting effectively, translating data into a clear story that shows clients not just what happened, but why it matters and what to do next. Often defines or improves that process rather than just following it.
  • Subject Matter Expert Across the Partnership Landscape: Is a trusted, knowledgeable resource on partner relationships and client verticals. Recognized as an SME not just on their own accounts but across the department.

Business Development and Publisher Relationships:

  • Proactive Research: Identifies and recruits high-quality partners with strong revenue potential. Regularly pursues more complex, or non-traditional partnership opportunities independently.
  • Written and Verbal Communication: Communications are clear, informative, and engaging.
  • Initiative: Proactively identifies and executes areas of opportunity and optimization to drive revenue growth. Leads end-to-end negotiations with an appropriate level of autonomy and collaboration.

  Top Partner Management

  • Relationship Management: Optimizes opportunities with top partners on behalf of the client. [Senior] Manages the most strategically important and/or highest-value partner relationships in the portfolio and negotiates complex terms independently.
  • Budget Management: Identifies and acts on opportunities that drive client growth while maintaining a healthy return on investment. Operates with wider latitude on ROI trade-off decisions given demonstrated judgment.
  • Time Management: Demonstrates exceptional calendar and time management skills.

Strategy and Execution:

  • Alignment to Client Strategy and Goals: Participates in engagement kickoff calls and ongoing calls as needed; maintains a clear understanding of client goals and KPIs.
  • Creation and Ongoing Ownership of Partner Strategy: Builds a recruitment and/or paid placement plan end-to-end, based on client goals and KPIs. Independently owns this process and often shapes the process/best practices other Growth Managers follow.
  • Strategy Pivots: Adapts and pivots strategies to reach client goals. Trusted to reset client expectations directly, including navigating difficult conversations, without requiring senior support at each step.
  • Internal Support & Mentorship: Collaborates with the Senior Account Manager and Program Director on upskilling around partner recruitment and optimization. Provides hands-on, direct support to team members on publisher best practices, and in some cases builds their knowledge of specific verticals or sectors.

  Pitching Opportunities:

  • Client Education and Alignment: Clearly articulates the “why” behind each opportunity and its expected value, including anticipated ROI.
  • Persuasiveness: Regularly develops and delivers persuasive pitches that secure larger or less conventional opportunities.
  • Partnership Ecosystem Knowledge: Maintains deep knowledge across partnership types. Recognized expertise others actively seek out.
  • Tenacity: Has a track record of overcoming objections. Coaches other Growth Managers on how to handle rejection productively.

By 6 Months

You've established yourself as a trusted strategic advisor to clients and built strong relationships with key partners across the affiliate ecosystem. You possess a deep understanding of client objectives, growth opportunities, and emerging partner models, allowing you to proactively shape recruitment and partnership strategies rather than simply execute against them. You consistently identify, evaluate, and activate high-impact partnership opportunities that drive measurable revenue and incremental growth. Your insights and market expertise help clients stay ahead of industry trends, and you are regularly sought out for recommendations on how to evolve their partnership mix and growth strategy.

By 1 Year

You're recognized as a subject matter expert and growth leader, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue and recruitment goals across your portfolio. You have developed scalable processes, frameworks, and best practices that improve team performance. Through a combination of strategic partner development, innovative activation planning, and strong cross-functional collaboration, you drive significant client growth and help shape long-term partnership roadmaps. You are known for uncovering new and emerging partner opportunities, successfully expanding clients into non-traditional partnership models, and delivering growth initiatives that create lasting business impact for both clients and AP.

QUALITIES OF THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

  • Growth-oriented and energized by identifying, pursuing, and closing new opportunities, equally motivated to find new partnerships and deepen existing ones, with a proven track record.
  • Natural relationship builder who proactively creates opportunities and strengthens relationships for clients and partners.
  • Enjoys building persuasive, data-grounded pitches for opportunities that aren’t obvious or conventional.
  • Strong aptitude for shaping partner strategy independently, without needing a playbook handed to them.
  • Self-starter who pursues opportunities of every size and complexity, and follows through without needing to be chased.
  • Builds trust fast, with partners, clients, and internal stakeholders, even in ambiguous or high-stakes situations.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a remote environment, exercising sound judgment with minimal oversight.
  • Communicates with confidence, poise, and clarity in front of client leadership and in high-stakes moments.
  • Exercises mature, independent judgment on when to escalate versus solve it themselves, and is trusted to get that call right.

Minimum Qualifications & Skills

  • 5–8 years of partnership/channel marketing experience. Affiliate marketing background required; direct exposure to creator partnerships, AEO, or retail media is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of independently closing larger or more complex deals, not just managing existing relationships.
  • Proven excellence in consistently meeting or exceeding revenue/recruitment targets at a senior level.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including experience presenting to clients.
  • Knowledge of affiliate networks, including Impact, Partnerize, CJ, and Awin.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for client meetings, industry conferences, and events

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!
  • Target Salary is $80,000 - $95,000 depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

 

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-JC2

About the Role

Are you a tech-savvy storyteller ready to lead the charge in Veeam’s data protection revolution? As a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Veeam Data Platform, you’ll transform complex technology into compelling, benefits-driven content. Your expertise across virtualization, cloud, enterprise applications, databases, HCI, security, governance, storage, and beyond will allow you to forge deep connections with technical audiences and ICPs. Join us to craft narratives that highlight Veeam’s innovation and values, resonating with both new prospects and loyal customers alike!

Your responsibilities will include leading the Veeam Data Platform outreach strategy, supporting campaigns with engaging demos, videos, and webinars, and working closely with Product Management, Strategy and Marketing to develop messaging for cutting-edge features. Your content will simplify complex tech concepts into easy-to-understand, actionable benefits, helping Veeam stand out in a competitive landscape.

Be the definitive voice of Product Marketing, bridging the gap between tech and value for customers, partners, and sales teams. Be capable of articulating Data Resiliency benefits to Execs and Practitioners alike. If you’re strategic, customer-focused, and passionate about bringing technical stories to life—this is your next career move.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and develop the product outreach, web and content strategy for Veeam Data Platform for customer acquisition and expansion.
  • Manage the lifecycle of all related assets, ensuring accuracy and relevance.
  • Be the resource, comfortable with working in the product capable of explaining realizable benefits on in a customer digestible story
  • Collaborate with product management and product strategy team to understand the values and craft compelling content for the latest Veeam innovations.
  • Design and support campaigns using technical know-how to create interactive Storylane/dynamic demos, presenter-led demos, technical videos, and webinars.
  • Develop and execute launch assets for new technologies and support.
  • Simplify technical benefits to resonate with end-users and partners, captivating prospects and maintaining loyal customers.
  • Partner with the PMM team to refine Veeam’s market positioning, tapping into your knowledge of competitive landscapes and buyer personas.
  • Build and apply deep proficiency in Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), buyer personas, and key use cases to sharpen messaging, targeting, and content strategy for a deeply technical product.

Technologies You’ll Work With

  • Veeam Data Platform
  • Virtualization technologies
  • Cloud platforms
  • Enterprise applications
  • Databases
  • Hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)
  • Security and governance technologies
  • Storylane and dynamic demo platforms
  • Webinar and video platforms
  • Salesforce and commercial technology ecosystems
  • AI-enabled productivity and automation tools

What You’ll Bring

  • 5-10 years in B2B software roles (technical sales, sales engineering, product marketing, or product management); backup, recovery, security, or monitoring experience preferred. Being Tech Savvy is necessary.
  • Strong business acumen, able to convey complex concepts as business value; experience with software, cloud, or aaS delivery is a plus.
  • Proficient in managing pipeline day-to-day, working closely with Campaigns, Marketing Operations, and Analytics teams, and identifying remediation when campaigns and sales flag signs of underperformance.
  • Skilled storyteller with the ability to communicate compelling technical visions, verbally and in writing, to drive business results.
  • Comfortable presenting product use cases to technical non-technical personas
  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on setting and improving metrics, KPIs, and impact.
  • Innovative thinker who challenges norms, experiments with new ideas, and drives market and mindshare growth.
  • Proactive leader capable of managing multiple projects autonomously and building new initiatives in a dynamic environment.
  • Collaborative team player who fosters alignment and executes on shared goals.
  • Customer-focused, prioritizing the entire customer journey.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or related field
  • Comfortable in a remote, global team environment; willing to travel up to 15%.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

At Cobalt, we are evolving the way we approach security research. We are looking for an Associate Security Researcher who doesn't just want to "break things," but who wants to understand the why and how behind the defense.

This is a unique "Purple Team" role. We are looking for a candidate with a strong foundational background in Systems Administration who wants to transition into security research. You will be the bridge between red and blue—using your knowledge of how systems are built to help us identify how they are compromised and, more importantly, how to protect them.

What You’ll Do

As an Associate on this team, you will be the backbone of our research operations. You will handle the foundational "grunt work" that powers our high-level research while being mentored to become a full-scale Security Researcher.

  • Foundation & Infrastructure: Leverage your sysadmin background to set up research environments, manage lab infrastructure, and ensure our tooling is stable.
  • Purple Team Collaboration: Assist in simulating threats (Red) while documenting detection gaps and defensive improvements (Blue).
  • Research Support: Perform data collection, log analysis, and initial vulnerability triaging to support Senior Researchers.
  • Documentation: Maintain high-quality documentation of research findings, scripts, and internal wikis.
  • Continuous Learning: Engage in a structured growth path to evolve from foundational sysadmin/support tasks into deep offensive security research.
  • Perform technical authorship and quality control for the TPM organization by reviewing penetration testing findings and final reports to ensure accuracy and actionable remediation guidance.

Who You Are

We aren't looking for a "hardcore pentester" who only cares about the exploit. We want a curious, methodical problem-solver who understands how a network breathes.

Required Qualifications:

  • The Sysadmin Spirit: You have a background in systems administration or IT operations. You understand servers, networking, permissions, and logs because you’ve managed them.
  • Security Mindset: You have a strong grasp of security fundamentals and likely hold certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, or are working toward an OSCP.
  • Pentesting Awareness: You understand the methodology of a penetration test (recon, scanning, exploitation), even if you haven't been a full-time pentester yet.
  • US-Based: For logistical and compliance reasons, this role is strictly limited to candidates residing in the United States.
  • Time Zone Alignment: Preference will be given to candidates in EST or CST to align with our team’s morning-heavy meeting schedule.

Bonus Points if:

  • You have experience with automation (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
  • You have an interest in cloud security (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • You enjoy "tinkering" in a home lab environment.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
  • Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
  • Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
  • Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
  • Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
  • Leverage stipends for:
    • Wellness
    • Work-from-home equipment & wifi
    • Learning & development
  • Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off, and paid parental leave

Pay Range Disclosure

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is ($55k - 70k ) per year + equity + benefits. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

Cobalt is an E-Verify employer. E-Verify is an Internet-based system operated by the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) in partnership with the Social Security Administration (SSA). It allows participating employers to electronically verify the employment eligibility of their newly hired employees in the United States.

jobs.jobDescription:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

This is a rare opportunity to help define a function and leave a fingerprint on how global healthcare packaging gets made. As our Principal Design Program Manager for International Packaging and Industrial Design, you won't just run programs; you'll establish the philosophy, frameworks, and standards that future DPMs will build on.

You'll be handed ambiguous, high-stakes problems and expected to bring structure, strategy, and a point of view in addition to consistent and quality execution. Your decisions will shape how design, marketing, supply chain, and operations work together at a systems level across three global markets.

We're building a design operations function that believes process and operations is a creative act, and that the best systems make great design possible. If you thrive in ambiguity, build with intention, and know how to make global design and packaging programs run, we'd love to talk.

You Will:

STRATEGIC IMPACT & ORGANIZATIONAL INFLUENCE

Define what great looks like

  • Establish the standard for how design operates globally: the frameworks, decision-making models, and principles you build become the foundation the team scales from.

  • Operate as the internal subject matter authority on global packaging program management. Leadership, design, legal, and supply chain turn to you for strategic counsel and guidance.

  • Contribute to process development, onboarding standards, and the craft development of the DPM function as it grows.

  • Build the frameworks other DPMs and future hires will use, this is as much about designing the operating system as running it.

Drive org-level prioritization

  • Design the global prioritization framework, the criteria, inputs, and escalation model that surface regional urgency, regulatory deadlines, creative capacity, and business impact, so that decision-makers can make faster, better-informed tradeoff calls.

  • Build the mechanisms (dashboards, briefing formats, escalation paths) that get the right tradeoffs in front of the right leaders before they become problems.

  • Influence roadmap and planning decisions across design, supply chain, and marketing by providing a clear, data-informed picture of capacity and risk.

PROGRAM EXECUTION & REGIONAL OWNERSHIP

Global program leadership

  • Architect and steer the end-to-end program model for packaging and print graphics across multiple regions, including AU, CAN, and UK, in close partnership with regional design and production teams. You are the connective tissue ensuring timeline integrity, dependency mapping, and risk visibility, not the sole executor of regional work.

  • Build and maintain strong regional relationships with design, marketing, supply chain, and legal counterparts in each market, trusted enough that people come to you early.

Compliance & regulatory fluency

  • Develop working knowledge of healthcare packaging compliance requirements across regions, and embed compliance checkpoints upstream in the creative process.

  • Translate regulatory requirements into clear creative briefs and review criteria that designers and legal can both work from.

Creative partnership

  • Partner with designers from brief through final production file, understanding creative intent well enough to protect it through the operational and compliance gauntlet.

  • Bring broad fluency across print graphics production, structural packaging, and industrial design/CMF — color management, dielines, press-ready specs, vendor pre-press workflows — enough to translate between disciplines, ask the right questions, and know where things typically break. You're not expected to be the deepest expert in any one domain, but you're the person who can speak all their languages and engage credibly in each conversation.

  • Build the mechanisms — capacity dashboards, resourcing reviews, structured tradeoff conversations — that make the creative team's bandwidth and constraints visible to stakeholders, so capacity conversations happen proactively with leadership rather than reactively with designers.

You Have:

  • 8-10+ years in design program management or creative operations, with meaningful time in healthcare, consumer goods, or a regulated packaging environment.

  • Proven track record building processes from scratch. You've created process infrastructure where little existed, and you're energized by that, not intimidated by it.

  • Broad packaging program expertise. You've owned programs from kickoff to press check and can speak to exactly where things typically go wrong to avoid it.

  • Demonstrated organizational influence. You've shaped how a team or function operates beyond your own programs, without relying on leadership to do it.

  • Experience designing prioritization frameworks that stakeholders actually adopt — not just building Gantt charts, but shifting how an org makes sequencing decisions.

  • Cross-disciplinary fluency in industrial design, structural packaging, and CMF — enough to be a credible partner across the full packaging design ecosystem, without needing to be the deepest expert in any one area.

  • Proficiency with PM tooling (Asana, Airtable, Google Suite, Dropbox) and comfort reviewing work in Figma.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack…
jobs.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About Deepgram

Deepgram is the foundational AI company for voice. We build the models that allow machines to hear, understand, and speak to humans with zero latency. As we scale our usage-based economy, we are building the "Intelligence Layer"—a system of autonomous agents that monitor, reason, and act on our data to drive NRR and operational excellence.

The Role

Reporting to the Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the founding engineer of the Data Intelligence team. While the Head of Data sets the strategic "Brain" of the company, you build the nervous system. You are not building legacy dashboards; instead you are building the API-based tools, dbt models, and semantic layers that allow AI agents to navigate our data environment autonomously.

Key Responsibilities

  • Semantic Layer Architecture: Build and maintain high-fidelity dbt and SQL models that serve as the "ground truth" for our complex, usage-based revenue models.

  • Agent Tooling & Integration: Develop the tools and permissions frameworks that allow "Analyst Agents" to query Athena, correlate Salesforce churn signals, and identify API latency issues.

  • Infrastructure Evolution: Serve as the technical bridge to the Engineering/Infra team to ensure our data contracts are "agent-ready" and highly reliable.

  • The "Unlock Audio Intelligence" Project: Partner with the Head of Data to ingest thousands of hours of internal calls using Deepgram’s own models, turning unstructured audio into queryable insights for GTM teams.

  • Automation Obsession: Maintain a culture where manual, repetitive SQL tasks are viewed as automation bugs to be solved with code and agents.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in high-growth Data or AI Engineering roles.

  • AI-Native Technical Skills: Mastery of SQL and Python (production-grade) with a proven track record of building RAG or Agentic systems on top of structured data.

  • Usage-Based SaaS Fluency: Familiarity with the metrics of an API-first business, such as consumption patterns, gross margins, and NRR.

  • Builder Mindset: Comfort with "work-in-progress" infrastructure and the ability to turn messy, siloed data into high-impact business logic.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience as a Software Engineer or Data Engineer.

  • Experience with real-time billing and consumption systems.

  • Contributions to open-source data or AI projects.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
LOCATION:

The Growth Manager is a remote, work from home position, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners (a structure central to our culture and our vision to change the work/life paradigm). Some travel is required, for client meetings or other internal meetings, conferences, etc.

THE ROLE:

Acceleration Partners is seeking a Growth Manager to drive partner growth strategies for some of our largest and most complex client programs. In this role, you will identify, develop, and scale high-impact partnerships that drive measurable revenue growth and help clients achieve their business objectives. You will shape recruitment, activation, and optimization strategies, uncover emerging growth opportunities, and influence partnership roadmaps beyond traditional affiliate models.

TOP 5 JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Revenue:

  • Publisher & Partner Performance: Contributes to client growth and retention by building high-potential partner relationships and optimizing performance.
  • Performance Trackers & Reporting: Follows client-approved processes for paid placements and partner optimizations. Uses reporting effectively, translating data into a clear story that shows clients not just what happened, but why it matters and what to do next.
  • Subject Matter Expert Across the Partnership Landscape: Is a trusted, knowledgeable resource on partner relationships and client verticals. Proactively leads conversations to share insights, adding value to the accounts they support and the broader department.

Business Development and Partner Relationships:

  • Proactive Research: Identifies and recruits high-quality partners with strong revenue potential based on client needs.
  • Written and Verbal Communication: Communications are clear, informative, and engaging. Asks relevant questions to vet opportunities effectively. Manages day-to-day communication with top partners in the program.
  • Initiative: Proactively identifies and executes areas of opportunity and optimization across the program to drive revenue growth.

  Top Partner Management

  • Relationship Management: Optimizes opportunities with top partners on behalf of the client. Views themselves as a true extension of the client's business and maintains long-lasting relationships with key partners.
  • Budget Management: Identifies and acts on opportunities that drive client growth while maintaining a healthy return on investment.
  • Time Management: Demonstrates exceptional calendar and time management skills.

Strategy and Execution:

  • Alignment to Client Strategy and Goals: Participates in engagement kickoff calls and ongoing calls as needed; maintains a clear understanding of client goals and KPIs.
  • Creation and Ongoing Ownership of Partner Strategy: Builds a recruitment and/or paid placement plan end-to-end (from strategy through execution) based on client goals and KPIs.
  • Strategy Pivots: Adapts and pivots strategies to reach client goals, resetting expectations when needed. Pushes back constructively on unrealistic client goals while preserving trust.

 

Pitching Opportunities:

  • Client Education and Alignment: Clearly articulates the "why" behind each opportunity and its expected value, including anticipated ROI.
  • Persuasiveness: Demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a willingness to challenge the status quo. Regularly identifies, pitches, and secures approval for innovative opportunities, grounded in data.
  • Partnership Ecosystem Knowledge: Maintains deep knowledge across partnership types and applies that expertise to confidently address client questions and identify opportunities.
  • Tenacity: Proactively explores the reasoning behind a rejection, thoughtfully pushes back when appropriate, and has a track record of overcoming objections.

What Success Looks Like

By 6 Months: You've developed strong relationships with your clients and their key partners, and have a firm grasp on the recruitment and reporting process. You're consistently sourcing and engaging partners who can drive real revenue and scale for your programs, meeting partner outreach goals as well as recruitment and revenue goals. You regularly bring relevant new partner opportunities to your clients and help keep AP on the forefront of affiliate publisher and partner models. Clients see you as someone who brings ideas, not just executes on them.

By 1 Year: You're consistently meeting or exceeding your goals and have established efficient reporting and recruitment processes, along with best practices that benefit the broader team. You've built a reputation for identifying opportunities that drive considerable revenue growth and for collaborating with partners and clients to develop new activation tactics that help clients exceed their goals. You've also successfully identified and activated non-traditional partner types for your clients.

Qualities of the ideal candidate:

  • Growth-oriented and energized by identifying, pursuing, and closing new opportunities, equally motivated to find new partnerships and deepen existing ones.
  • Natural relationship builder who proactively creates opportunities and strengthens relationships for clients and partners.
  • Enjoys building persuasive, data-grounded pitches that connect new opportunities directly to client goals.
  • Strong aptitude for developing partner strategy informed by publisher business models and client objectives.
  • Builds new relationships quickly and establishes credibility fast with clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating independently in a remote environment, exercising sound judgment with minimal oversight.
  • Communicates with confidence, poise, and clarity, especially under pressure or in high-stakes conversations.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment and brings their own structure and prioritization to it.
  • Exercises mature, measured judgment; solves problems independently but knows when to escalate or loop others in.
  • Takes full ownership of their work: consistently meets commitments and delivers quality without close supervision.

Minimum qualifications & skills:

  • 2–5 years of partnership/channel marketing experience. Affiliate marketing background required; direct exposure to content partnerships, AEO, or retail media is a strong plus.
  • Demonstrated track record of self-generating new business.
  • Proven excellence in meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Knowledge of affiliate networks, including Impact, Partnerize, CJ, and Awin.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% for client meetings, industry conferences, and events.

WHY ACCELERATION PARTNERS?

Acceleration Partners is the world’s largest and first-to-market Partnership Marketing Agency creating and nurturing partnerships that drive exceptional measurable outcomes for their clients. Managing clients in 40+ countries, their global team of 300+ focuses on data-driven strategies that help connect brands to the right consumers through performance partnerships, traditional affiliate, influencer, performance PR, content, and B2B partnership marketing.

AP PERKS & BENEFITS - WHAT WE OFFER

  • 100% remote work for everyone
  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage insurance (with opt-out benefits)
  • 401K with matching
  • Open Paid Time Off
  • Summer & Holiday Wellness Breaks in July and December
  • Volunteer and Birthday Time Off
  • Focus Fridays
  • Paid Parental Leave Benefits
  • Wellness, Technology & Education Allowances
  • Paid sabbatical leaves, donation matching, and more!!
  • Target Salary is $70,000 - $85,000 depending on location and experience.

Benefits may vary based on employment status or country location.

 

Acceleration Partners is committed to a diverse workforce and we are an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants regardless of an individual’s age, race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

 

#LI-REMOTE 

*GLSDR

#LI-MG1

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:

Veeam is seeking a Senior Partner Manager – Data & AI Security to grow our Securiti practice across our most strategic partners. Reporting into channel leadership, you’ll drive Data & AI Security channel sales for high-priority national and regional partners alongside Veeam Channel Managers, who own the relationship.

You’ll shape Veeam’s channel go-to-market for Data & AI Security, building replicable playbooks, campaigns, and playbooks to uncover Securiti business. You’re a channel leader who has built new practices within established partners, drives accountability without friction, and brings deep domain expertise, sales enablement capabilities, and executive credibility.

What You'll Do:

Pipeline & Revenue

  • Own Data & AI Security partner revenue and pipeline targets, including planning and forecasting.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline through account mapping, joint campaigns and co-selling, and support high-value deals through close.

Channel Strategy

  • Lead Data & AI Security strategy and pipeline motion in each partnership; Veeam Channel Managers retain relationship ownership.
  • Build rules of engagement, playbooks and frameworks that scale the overlay model.
  • Represent partners to internal teams to shape programs, incentives, and roadmap.

Executive Engagement & Planning

  • Secure partner executive sponsorship for the Data & AI Security practice that each plan requires.
  • Assess partner potential and build multi-year joint business plans with revenue, enablement and services goals.
  • Lead Data & AI Security business reviews and hold stakeholders accountable to commitments.

Practice Development & Enablement

  • Recruit and activate partner sellers, engineers and services teams at scale.
  • Lead sales enablement across Data Security, DSPM, AI Security, AI Governance, Privacy and GRC.
  • Help partners build repeatable service offerings, sales plays and competitive positioning.

Measures of Success

  • Attainment of partner-sourced and partner-influenced Data & AI Security pipeline and revenue targets.
  • Number of strategic partners with an active, revenue-generating Data & AI Security practice, and growth in registered opportunities, net-new customers and average deal size.
  • Execution of joint business plans and the strength of executive alignment with partners and Veeam channel leadership.
  • Adoption of partner-led assessments, services and solutions, and partner participation in enablement and certification.
  • Scalability of the playbooks and programs developed, and their adoption across the wider channel team.
  • Forecast accuracy and return on partner marketing and enablement investment.

What You'll Bring:

  • Significant channel or alliances experience managing strategic or national-level partners.
  • A record of exceeding revenue targets through VARs, MSPs, and/or GSIs.
  • Success building a new practice within established partners in an overlay model.
  • Experience shaping channel strategy and executing it.
  • Executive presence with C-level partner leaders.
  • Command of partner-led selling, pipeline management and forecasting.
  • Cybersecurity, data governance, privacy or AI security expertise, fluent in DSPM, AI Governance and GRC.
  • Ability to turn technical capabilities into business outcomes and to influence without authority.
  • Experience mentoring peers and channel teams and guiding sales reps through partner processes.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with DSPM, AI governance, privacy or GRC platforms.
  • Experience building partner-led services practices.
  • Security, privacy or cloud certifications (e.g., CIPP, CISSP).

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE)

$210,720—$391,200 USD

Zone 2: Washington, California (excluding San Francisco Bay Area)

$193,160—$358,600 USD

Zone 3: Texas, Illinois, North Carolina, Colorado, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Oregon, Nevada, Hawaii, New York (excluding NYC boroughs); Sales roles located in Georgia, Ohio, and Arizona

$175,600—$326,000 USD

Zone 4: All other US locations

$152,772—$283,620 USD

All your information will be kept confidential.

Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice, which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing.

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?

Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.

By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.

Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.

What You’ll Need

- Native or near-native fluency in Danish

- Based in: Denmark, United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Sweden, Spain, Greenland, France, Faroe Islands

- English proficiency

- Comfortable with digital tools

- Detail-oriented and curious

Why Join Us?

Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow

Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI

Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community

About our projects:

Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.

Depending on your skills, you might:

Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems

Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance

Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)

Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy

Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.

How to Apply?

Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.

Questions?

If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Compensation

jobs.jobDescription:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven Customer Success Manager to join our Americas team.

What you’ll be doing:

As a Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximize opportunities for our SMB customers and Semperis.

Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions.

You will be responsible for:

  • Designing success plans for a Book of Business of approximately 50 SMB customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upselling, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to help them reach their business objectives and operational goals.

  • You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets.

  • Acting as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs.

  • Leading training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations.

  • Monitoring record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalized customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc.

  • Developing and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.)

  • Identifying potential customer references and assisting with development of customer case studies.

  • Gain and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services.

  • In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program.

What you will bring to the table:

Technical & Cyber Security Skills

  • Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities.

  • Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organization structures

Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains:

  • Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc.

  • Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2)

Customer-facing & Soft Skills

  • 3+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager, technical account manager, or related customer-facing role in a Cybersecurity SaaS solutions company.

  • Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language.

  • Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives.

  • Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities.

  • Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations

  • Consultative selling & value realization: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals.

Business & Strategic Skills

  • Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics)

  • Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps)

  • Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths)

  • Competitive intelligence: Know how our product differentiates from the competition.

Preferences:

  • Experience with SFDC and Active Directory

#LI-KG1

You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Americas Sales Business Partner Manager.

About the job

We are seeking an Americas Sales Business Partner Manager (SBP) to serve as the right hand Sales Ops leader to leaders across the Americas Sales organization. In this role, you will be instrumental in ensuring alignment between sales strategy and execution, fostering collaboration across teams, and driving operational excellence that accelerates growth and delivers measurable results for your verticals. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Sales Operations leader with deep go-to-market (GTM) and enterprise-scale software/tech experience in sales strategy. Success requires tight alignment and collaboration with your peer Sales Operations functional leaders ( Strategic Operations, Sales Compensation, GTM Initiatives and GTM Analytics, GTM Enablement) and company-wide cross-functional teams such as HR, finance, marketing, product and more.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be the Business partner to GTM leaders; challenge the status quo.
  • Shape & execute business strategy to address risks / obstacles / opportunities.
  • Translate strategy into actionable operational plans & execute.
  • Be the Voice of sales in cross-functional initiatives.
  • Execute operational cadences at the Vertical/Segment level supporting a Regional VP of Sales
  • Manage forecast and pipeline health; drive predictability for month/quarter/year.
  • Provide business performance insights; facilitate decision-making.
  • Produce recurring & ad hoc exec business updates.
  • Engage & deliver on localized planning & sales ops activities (e.g. headcount, Annual Planning, New Year Readiness, Account Movements, Territory & Quota operationalization) in alignment with Strategic Operations peer function.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in sales operations, sales, strategy consulting; minimum 2+ years directly partnering with senior software/tech sales leaders ($1B+ sales orgs).
  • Proficiency in sales planning and operations including sales coverage, segmentation, territory planning, sales compensation strategy and executing a rhythm of business (MBRs, QBRs, etc).
  • Problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to influence and align senior leadership and teams.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years' of experience; graduate degree a plus.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 20, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.
